headline: South Africa Vehicle Sales Rise 10.4% as Market Targets 600,000 Milestone
summary: South African vehicle sales increased by 10.4%, though higher interest rates and rising fuel costs continue to weigh on consumer affordability as the market aims for 600,000 units.
why: Automotive sales data serves as a key indicator of consumer discretionary spending and durable goods demand within South Africa's economy.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Higher vehicle sales volumes reflect growth in domestic consumer demand despite headwinds.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
